script: What happens when an NBA player has to use the bathroom during a game? You see, players can't waste a time out, so they usually signal to the coach or leave for the locker room. However, there's been cases where players needed to pee in secret, as there's been stories of players using trash cans, towels, and even cups just so they don't miss a single second of game time. But the craziest example has to be Paul Pierce, who faked an injury and had to use a wheelchair because he pooped his pants.
